accountPerformance.title: Account assets and returns
accountPerformance.chooseAccount: Choose an account in the header. Independent SIM budgets are not automatically combined here.
accountPerformance.noHistory: No samples in this range. History starts with actual measurements; earlier equity is not fabricated.
accountPerformance.noValuation: These samples have no complete valuation. Review balance and price sources in the details.
accountPerformance.partial: Returns and drawdown require at least two complete samples. Missing valuations or funding flows are not zero.
accountPerformance.invalidRange: End must follow start and the range cannot exceed 366 days.
accountPerformance.limited: Only the latest 1000 samples are shown. Metrics use the displayed coverage; narrow the range to inspect earlier periods.
accountPerformance.chartLabel: Measured account equity curve. Exact values are in the sample details below.
accountPerformance.method: Scope: the selected account's NQ-managed projection, not its entire exchange balance. Projections already include positions. Valuation uses visible closed spot bars no older than two hours, with source identities. Net P&L = final equity − initial equity − period net funding. Return = net P&L / initial equity, not TWR. Drawdown uses the flow-adjusted sampled curve, not tick-level drawdown. Quote: USDT. Only canonical SIM funding currently has complete flow coverage. Samples are taken approximately every fifteen minutes and retained for 366 days. Missing samples remain missing. Amounts display up to eight decimals and ratios four; details retain exact values.

performanceStatistics.chartLabel: Reconstructed independent SIM equity curve; event times and exact values are in the table below
performanceStatistics.method: Sharpe uses equity adjusted for net funding within this coverage, a zero risk-free rate and population variance; it is not annualized and requires consecutive sampling buckets. Outcomes use weighted entry cost and the net result of each sell fill, including signed fees or rebates. Partial closes count once; flat closes enter the denominator, open buys do not. Execution prices already include slippage. Earlier trades establish entry cost; only closes after the first valuation through the last valuation (inclusive) count, matching the equity-change period. The profit/loss ratio is undefined without losses.
performanceStatistics.historyTitle: Independent SIM · equity and return history
performanceStatistics.outcomeTitle: Independent SIM · closed outcomes and statistics
performanceStatistics.replayMeaning: Historical replay reconstructs achieved canonical fills at their simulated execution events, using visible signal closes or saved execution quotes. Execution quotes take priority at the same time. The axis uses replay event time; actual ledger update time is separate. This instance is not combined with an account or a backtest curve.
performanceStatistics.actualMeaning: Continuous SIM uses actual fill times and saved signal prices or execution quotes, after actual funding. A fill after the last mark waits for the next available price and is not included at an earlier time.
performanceStatistics.afterCoverage: {{count}} fills are later than this history coverage and are excluded from its metrics. Current assets and this history are shown separately.

priceEventTimes.storageUnavailable: The pending slot is unavailable, occupied or could not be cleared. A new request is never sent without a stored identity. Keep the original request for verification.
priceEventTimes.otherPending: The pending request belongs to another candle or an earlier version. Verification still checks the original record.
priceEventTimes.readonly: Your role, candle quality or interval state does not allow import. Existing sources remain readable.
priceEventTimes.formatDescription: The scope and prices below belong to this candle. Replace the four null values with actual source-provided ISO times, with a timezone and up to microseconds. Do not fill unknown times with candle boundaries.

notes.conflict: The stored record differs from the original request. The pending request is retained; check the source and candle version.

updateHandoff.title: Check and update handoff
updateHandoff.scope: Prepare requests and reconcile receipts here; execute them with the original installer on the target host. A successful check still requires update confirmation, followed by runtime version and health verification.
updateHandoff.uninstalled: This service has no valid installed package identity. A bare service version cannot initiate an installation update.
updateHandoff.storageFailed: The saved update record could not be restored. New requests are blocked to preserve the original identity. Check the host installer records.
updateHandoff.invalid: Input, receipt identity or local storage validation failed. The original request is retained. Check the environment, manifest and original receipt. Consumed receipts cannot be imported again.
updateHandoff.status_CHECKED: Installer check completed; update not yet confirmed
updateHandoff.status_FAILED: Installer recorded a failure; check recovery status
updateHandoff.status_SUCCEEDED: Installer reports success; runtime verification pending
updateHandoff.awaitReceipt: No original installer receipt has been imported. Neither success nor failure is inferred from waiting.
updateHandoff.newCheck: Retain final result and begin a new check
updateHandoff.confirmMeaning: Create an update request bound to this check. Execute it on the target host with the original installer, which still validates the package, asks for confirmation and owns backup and rollback. This page does not execute host commands.
updateHandoff.runtimeVerified: Execution receipt, running version and health match
updateHandoff.runtimeMismatch: The current runtime does not yet match the target package or health. Retain the original request and check the target host.
updateHandoff.hostInstructions: Process the downloaded file with the original installer on the target host. Requests contain no commands or host paths. Receipts are saved under runtime/handoffs/<original-request-ID>/receipt.json.
updateHandoff.receiptBoundary: This page checks correlation and duplicate imports, not digital signatures. The installer independently validates the package and its local check receipt. An update grants no trading permission.

systemVersion.title: Version and updates
systemVersion.readFailed: Current version information could not be read.
systemVersion.noPackage: This service has no installer package identity; package version and update availability cannot be determined.
systemVersion.invalid: Installed package identity is incomplete or malformed. Check the installation configuration.
systemVersion.installerScope: Update checks, updates, backups and rollback use the formal installer on the installation host.
systemVersion.steps: View update check and execution steps
systemVersion.prepare: Obtain the official target package and an independently trusted manifest SHA256. Open a terminal on the installation host and replace the directory and hash placeholders below.
systemVersion.checkStep: 1. Check the target package without updating
systemVersion.checkDescription: check-update verifies the installed VERSION, target package and trusted manifest, and reports current/available versions and update availability. It changes neither service nor database.
systemVersion.confirmDescription: After reviewing the target version, run update. The installer will still require UPDATE confirmation. Stop at the check result if you do not choose to update; do not use automatic confirmation flags.
systemVersion.otherPlatform: Applies only within the existing POSIX installer support contract. Follow the installation guide; this view does not establish new platform qualification.
systemVersion.recovery: Updates retain installer preflight, backup and transaction recovery. Rollback after a database migration may require the matching backup restore. Follow the formal installation guide.
